newsitem.title: USA: Crane Co says Q3 to exceed estimates.
newsitem.headline: Crane Co says Q3 to exceed estimates.

text.p: Crane Co said Friday it expected its third-quarter earnings to exceed analysts' consensus estimate by about 10 percent.

The company said the improvement reflected a combination of property sales, a lower effective tax rate and stronger earnings from operations. It did not specify the consensus to which it was referring.
According to Standard & Poor's Market Focus, the consensus estimate for the third quarter is $0.78 per share.
The company posted net income of $22,029, or $0.71 per share, in last year's third quarter.
Crane manufactures engineered industrial products and distributes doors, windows and millwork.
